responsibility: This header declares the public data formats and entry points for emitting BPF .BTF.ext information. It defines the stable on-disk structures and relocation-kind enums for func_info and CO-RE relocation records, and exposes the APIs used elsewhere in the BPF backend to initialize/output the section, register CO-RE relocation requests, look up structure-member indexes, add function info, and intern strings for the associated BTF string table.
same_name_distinction: Declares the interface and file-format contracts for the .BTF.ext emitter—stable header/record structs, relocation-kind enums, and APIs such as btf_ext_init, btf_ext_output, and bpf_core_reloc_add—whereas btfext-out.cc contains the private linked-list state and the actual construction/assembly emission logic.
